goal: A first hour that is fun on a phone: gather, loot, craft, build and skill up in one loop that pays out, on islands worth looking at. Then the Durango-style long game (capture and ride, regional trade, city islands) and the online world, with balance last and every step checked against a bot-run beat sheet instead of vibes.
seed_note: Statuses checked 2026-10-30 against the merges into claude/mmo-overhaul up to 4aa0ba62 (NORTHFOLLOW) and the reports in docs/orchestration/reports/. 'next' = queued now; a feature is buildable when its dependencies are done. Correct a status in-page (it becomes a mark) or restructure here.
